bio.text: Jason Shoaf represents District 7 in the Florida House of Representatives, to which Shoaf was first elected on June 18, 2019.
Shoaf lives in Port St. Joe, works in the natural gas and propane utility business, and was born in Panama City, Florida.
Shoaf attended Tallahassee Community College and Florida State University.
